crm_notes: Summary: Mid-market e-commerce returns platform focusing on post-purchase customer experience (RMA, refund status, shipping tracking). Evaluating Redwood hosted API for initial POC; interested in Dedicated for seasonal peak headroom (Black Fri/Cyber Mon) and VPC for data isolation.

Primary goals: automated chat agent to reduce live-agent load on returns/shipping, sub-350ms p95 for streaming chat responses when invoking carrier APIs (tool-calls), maintain SLA during 3x traffic spikes in peak season.
Cost posture: moderately cost-sensitive — willing to pay for dedicated capacity during peak windows but wants clear unit economics and batching/quantization recommendations from Redwood Optimize.

Security: SOC2 in vendor checklist, SSO/SAML required, audit logging + KMS for encryption at rest. They flagged potential EU reseller customers requiring data residency; need controls for regional routing.
Quote from CPO: 'We need the bot to feel instantaneous for customers checking return status. 500ms feels slow; 200–300ms is ideal for streaming replies.'

POC scope: 4-week sandbox with real RMA dataset (anonymized), 2 agent flows (returns lookup + shipping ETA), tool-calls to carrier API simulators, load scenario: 3k concurrent sessions with 10k tokens/session peak simulation (Black Fri replica).

Demo notes (2026-03-02): ran hosted streaming demo with tool-calling example (carrier lookup). SE Lucas showed fallback policy to smaller model when NVidia capacity constrained. Customer liked streaming but worried about p95 tail on turnkey hosted plan.

Security review: Sent security questionnaire 2026-02-20 (drive link). InfoSec asked for KMS integration diagram and retention controls. Redwood provided draft architecture; Sec team submitted follow-up ticket SEC-5572.
POC status: In progress — sandbox keys handed out 2026-03-05, initial integration completed 2026-03-09, functional tests green. Load test scheduled 2026-03-18 (Lucas + infra team).
Commercial: discussed 12-month dedicated / seasonal burst pricing model. Finance asked for two options: committed baseline + burst pool vs. pure consumption. Pricing deck shared (drive).

Next steps list: run load tests w/ realistic token lengths; measure p95 streaming with tool calls; provide Optimize recommendations (batching, KV cache) and estimated cost delta for quantized model; prepare exec pricing review.
Short-term risks: If p95 target not met on hosted tier, they'll push for Dedicated earlier which requires faster procurement and contract terms.
